card.name: Playful asides in casual web prose
card.fires_on: Words or punctuation inside a lighthearted, jokey or whimsical remark in casual web writing, often just before the punchline or aside is completed. The word itself varies (of, the, !, cloudy, possible, hits).

modes.description: Mock-serious wording in a joke about cats or weather, at a small linking word or a pun word.

modes.label: Chatty blog aside
modes.description: Casual, upbeat personal or blog sentences, at an exclamation mark, comma or a wry word.

card.writes: Weak signal; it slightly favors Chinese words of negative judgment (cowardly, insult, helpless, selfish) and disfavors words of humor and delight.
card.plain: It lights up in tongue-in-cheek, playful passages, mostly at small words partway through a joke.
